summary: Fix TOCTOU race condition in _ensure_parent_directory by using atomic mkdir

implementation_details.approach: Use atomic mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) instead of separate existence check and mkdir
key_changes: Removed separate existence check loop that created TOCTOU window
Handle NotADirectoryError after mkdir to identify file-as-directory conflicts
Added docstring explaining the atomic pattern

risks_limitations: Minimal risk - the fix makes the directory creation atomic and handles errors post-hoc
acceptance_criteria_met: Directory creation is atomic with error handling for file-as-directory conflicts
No TOCTOU window between existence check and directory creation
